preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 300,000.
The number of edges m must be at least n - 1 and at most 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= d[i] <= 1 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each vertex degree requirement d[i] must be -1, 0, or 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not exists_good_subset else True
postconditions.description: If no good subset of edges exists, output -1.

postconditions.expression: len(edges_in_subset) == k and all(1 <= edge_index <= m for edge_index in edges_in_subset)
postconditions.description: The output must contain k edges, where k is the number of edges in the good subset, and each edge index must be valid.

postconditions.expression: all((d[i] == -1 or (degree[i] % 2 == d[i])) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For every vertex, if d[i] is not -1, its degree in the subset must match d[i] modulo 2.
